items.actClause:
AN ACT authorizing the alienation of certain parklands in the village of
Tarrytown, in the town of Greenburgh, in the county of Westchester
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5111

SPONSOR: HARCKHAM
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act authorizing the alienation of certain parklands
in the village of Tarrytown, in the town of Greenburgh, in the county of
Westchester

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the Village of Tarrytown to discontinue the use of certain
land presently dedicated for parkland to complete a transfer of land
previously agreed to by the Village and to make an undersized and irreg-
ularly shaped parcel more zoning compliant.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 authorizes the village of Tarrytown to discontinue as park-
lands and alienate certain lands for the purpose of completing a trans-
fer of land previously agreed to by the village and to make an under-
sized and irregularly shaped parcel more zoning compliant.

Section 2 provides that the authorization provided in section one of the
act will only be effective on the condition that the village of Tarry-
town dedicate the lands described in section 4 as parkland; provided
that the village has never used such lands for public open space
purposes.

Section 3 provides a legal description of the parklands to be discontin-
ued.

Section 4 describes the replacement land to be acquired and dedicated by
the village of Tarrytown as parkland.

Section 5 provides that in the event the land acquired and dedicated as
parklandis not equal to or greater than the fair market value of the
parklands to be alienated, the village of Tarrytown shall acquire and
dedicate additional land for parkland and/or funds to be made available
for capital improvements to its existing park and recreational facili-
ties, as necessary, to equal such difference in fair market value.

Section 6 provides that if the village of Tarrytown received any funding
support or assistance from the federal government for the purchase,
maintenance or improvement of the parklands to be alienated, the discon-
tinuance and alienation of the parkland shall not occur until the
village of Tarrytown has complied with any federal requirements pertain-
ing to the lands including compliance with any conditions imposed by the
secretary of the interior.

Section 7 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

In 2011 the Village of Tarrytown purchased 11.38 acres of land that was
part of a subdivision that created both open space parcels and parcels
to be developed. As part of the subdivision planning the Village Plan-
ning Board agreed to sell a small parcel of land (approximately 3,301
sq.ft.) to a neighboring property owner in order to make their property
more zoning compliant. During the course of the review process which

took several years, this agreed the transfer of land was inadvertently
overlooked.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state. Undetermined for the local government.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Discontinues the use of a parcel of land within the village of Tarrytown and alienates the parcel for the purpose of transferring land previously agreed to by the village and also to make an undersized and irregularly shaped parcel more zoning compliant.
title: Relates to discontinuing the use of land within the village of Tarrytown as parkland and alienating the parcel
